preconditions.description: The number of horses n is at least 1.
The number of enemy pairs m is non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in enemy_pairs)
preconditions.description: Each enemy pair consists of two distinct horse indices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(len([1 for u, v in enemy_pairs if u == i or v == i]) <= 3 for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Each horse has at most 3 enemies.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted((u, v))) for u, v in enemy_pairs)) == len(enemy_pairs)
preconditions.description: No enemy pair is repeated in the input.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout) if solution_exists else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: If a valid assignment exists, the output is a string of length n containing only '0' and '1'; otherwise, it is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: solution_exists implies all(sum(1 for u, v in enemy_pairs if (u == i or v == i) and (assignment[u-1] == assignment[v-1])) <= 1 for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, for every horse, the number of enemies in the same party is at most 1.

postconditions.expression: not solution_exists implies not any(all(sum(1 for u, v in enemy_pairs if (u == i or v == i) and (c[u-1] == c[v-1])) <= 1 for i in range(1, n + 1)) for c in ['0'*n, '1'*n])
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, no valid assignment satisfies the condition (output is -1).
